definition.maya: The power that makes the unreal appear real and the real appear hidden.

how_maya_operates.description: The soul identifies with body, name, role

shiva_voice: The world does not bind you. Your belief does.
Māyā is My power, not your prison.
I did not trap you in illusion. You forgot Me.
practice: See emotions as movements, not identity
Return to awareness again and again
